desc: 折纸雾李台座与墨紫深场，十屏日间防护详情节奏
name: 折纸雾紫清透面部防晒霜款

shots.intent: 详情首屏一秒抓住注意力，用双支错落与折纸棱面立住整组视觉基调
shots.textZone: top 22 percent reserved for the headline rail, one slim pill rail directly beneath it

shots.intent: 承接首屏，在墨紫深场上用三条编号空白栏把核心利益一次讲完
shots.textZone: left column, three stacked numbered rails running top to bottom

shots.intent: 把上妆搓泥、油光、暗沉与脱妆四类日常挫败做成同格同光的四格拼贴，放大问题
shots.textZone: one short label rail per panel, plus a headline band above the grid

shots.intent: 用管肩与盖沿的微距质感证明工艺与膏体外观，把机制页落到实物上
shots.textZone: one short label at the lower right corner

shots.intent: 以同框同光的双格对照呈现受光强弱的视觉差，让买家自己看出差别
shots.textZone: one short label at the head of each panel

shots.intent: 用三片重叠圆碟与空白留样位承载成分叙事，只给结构不给任何配方事实
shots.textZone: three leader-line labels, one per disc, plus one headline block at the upper right

shots.intent: 把商品参数与四枚功能图标做成可填充的信息结构，消除规格疑虑
shots.textZone: icon chip rail above the card, one label per card row left blank for copy

shots.intent: 用三步空白教程卡与晨间台面让买家代入日常使用动作
shots.textZone: three step cards ruled across the upper left, one short label each

shots.intent: 以未修饰的手背推开实证承担口碑位，只用空白引述条不写评价内容
shots.textZone: one quote rail on the right with a short placeholder label

shots.intent: 收口单支正身展示并留一块空白动作板，把转化位交回给运营填写
shots.textZone: one action plate at the foot of the frame plus two empty tick slots

style.backgroundSystem: hand-pleated mist-lilac paper sweep #E7E3EE with standing vertical knife folds, interchangeable with one deep ink-violet paper field #2F2A45 and paper-white card faces #FAF9FD; horizon-free, no outdoor scenery, no water
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in ink violet #2F2A45 inside blank rounded square chips, no filled badges, no medals, no seal artwork
style.lightingSystem: one large scrim-softened top-front softbox as the single key, one cool bounce card on the shadow side, narrow crisp shadows falling only along the paper folds, low-contrast modeling, at most one thin specular line per surface, no hard-edged shadow bands
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent sculpted paper-studio skincare system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pleated mist-lilac paper field #E7E3EE, greyed-lilac folded plinth #CFC9DE, deep ink-violet paper field #2F2A45, paper-white card face #FAF9FD and a single iris-lilac accent #B4A0E4; cool temperature throughout; lighting from one large scrim-softened top-front softbox with one cool bounce card, narrow crisp shadows confined to the paper folds, low contrast, at most one thin specular line and never a hard-edged shadow band; every background is hand-pleated paper or ink-violet paper, horizon-free, never stone, sand, shell, glass, plaster, cloud, water or outdoor scenery; the product always rests on a chamfered folded-paper riser with a visible soft contact shadow; one modern geometric sans-serif family, headline plus at most two short label rails, all copy left as placeholders; thin single-weight line glyphs inside blank rounded square chips only; stable product scale and angle per role; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented credentials.
noDrift: no color palette changes outside mist-lilac #E7E3EE, folded plinth #CFC9DE, ink violet #2F2A45 and iris lilac #B4A0E4
no pleated-paper background replaced by stone, sand, shell, glass, plaster, cloud, down or any outdoor surface
no hard-edged louver shadow band, no low sun streak, no backlit gel flag glow
no mixed fonts, no handwritten or script lettering
no invented certificate frames, seals, ratings or review copy
style.presentationRules: product scale held within one band per role band 40-70 percent, upright or leaning against a paper riser, label face always readable, never floating without a contact shadow, never duplicated inside one frame
style.surfaceSystem: chamfered folded-paper plinth blocks and risers in greyed lilac #CFC9DE with knife-edge creases and a dry matte paper nap; the product always sits on a paper edge with a visible soft contact shadow
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; headline plus two short label rails maximum, all copy carried as placeholders
